value.rationale: Opposing individual susceptibility and infectiousness make same-type versus mixed household pairing a natural mechanistic choice while preserving both marginal type frequencies and all individual traits. The complete all-contrast, all-intensity classification and unique crossover locate a genuine intervention-sensitive invasion-threshold boundary. Two exact rational calibrations demonstrate that the ordering can decide opposite possible-major-outbreak verdicts, which is a qualitative rather than merely numerical difference.
